post_clip.description: Multiple individuals are engaged in mutual physical combat: two people in the center (one in dark jacket, one in light top) are actively exchanging punches and grappling, with aggressive postures and dynamic movement consistent with fighting. Others nearby appear to be intervening or observing closely, but the core interaction meets the definition of mutual combat—both parties throwing strikes and maintaining offensive stances.

Multiple individuals are engaged in mutual combat: two or more people are actively throwing punches and adopting aggressive postures toward each other. In frames 31.5s–37.5s, a group in the center of the platform is seen grappling, with at least two participants exchanging strikes (e.g., raised arms, lunging motions, defensive stances). One person appears to be pushed or struck backward around frame 34s–35s, consistent with active fighting. No law enforcement present; behavior matches definition of mutual combat.

A physical altercation is occurring: multiple individuals are engaged in mutual combat—two or more people are actively throwing punches/kicks at each other with aggressive postures. One person is on the ground while others surround and strike them; others nearby appear to be intervening or joining the fight. The scene shows clear signs of fighting consistent with the expected anomaly type.
